title: Children who witnessed the Irkutsk lights

tellings.quote: I heard a rumble, and then I saw a pink light. Everything was lit with pink color. I thought it was an alien.

plain: In 2011, children in the Irkutsk region of Siberia described a rumble followed by a light that turned everything pink; one said, "I thought it was an alien." Michels plays or quotes this from a report on Russian Channel 1, a state television station. The account is offered as ordinary witnesses describing an unexplained light in the sky.
